svg.title: Carriers set rho; changing the card requires a new solve
svg.desc: PB and depletion volume charge are different approximations. n and p use logarithmic density; ratios expose nondegenerate condition. The right boundary change is an equilibrium electrostatic clamp with a common Fermi energy, not a biased two-reservoir device.

g.text: Carriers set rho; changing the card requires a new solve
Synthetic A/B, 300 K, equilibrium MB; same 1.25 nm data
E_F = -0.5 eV. Sheet charge is C/m² at x=0; it is not plotted as volume rho.
